# TerraFusion OS Backend Documentation - AI Coding Agent Instructions

## Project Architecture Overview

TerraFusion OS Backend Documentation is the comprehensive knowledge repository for the multi-workspace architecture:
- `docs/backend/` - Strategic documentation and government excellence frameworks (current workspace)
- `backend/` - Server-side implementation documented through strategic phases
- `SDK/` - Integration documentation and API specifications
- `config/` - Configuration documentation and schema references
- `infrastructure/` - Deployment documentation and cloud resources
- `tests/` - Testing documentation and quality assurance protocols
